title: Mark support vectors on the kernel boundary plot
description: You overlay selected training rows on the model's decision display.

steps.description: You create axes and define sign_k to return ksvm.decision(Z). The wrapper forwards the model's decision values.
You pass the training features, labels, and decision helper to plot_data_and_boundary. Its title identifies the radial-basis-function kernel model.

steps.question: Where do the highlighted support-vector coordinates come from?
steps.answer: They are rows of X_tr selected by ksvm.sv_idx. The code uses the training feature coordinates directly.

steps.description: You overlay those rows with unfilled markers and black edges. The final display distinguishes support vectors from the underlying training scatter.
